look.why: A lush Southeast-Asian-forest emerald pastel that sets off its overlapping olive-brown keratin scales.

size.measure: total length, 0.9–1.2 m including prehensile tail

habitat.text: Primary and secondary tropical forests, peat swamps and wooded gardens across Southeast Asia.

diet.text: Tree-nesting ants and termites, extracted with a sticky tongue longer than its entire body.

facts.text: The world's only truly scaly mammal—its overlapping armour scales are made of keratin, the same protein as human fingernails.
When threatened, it curls into an impenetrable armoured ball that even a tiger's jaws cannot crack open.

id.habitat: Hutan hujan tropis primer dan sekunder, rawa gambut, serta kebun berhutan di Asia Tenggara.
id.diet: Semut dan rayap pohon yang diambil menggunakan lidah lengket yang lebih panjang dari seluruh tubuhnya.
facts: Satu-satunya mamalia bersisik sejati di dunia—sisik pelindungnya terbuat dari keratin, protein yang sama dengan kuku manusia.
Saat terancam, ia menggulung menjadi bola zirah rapat yang bahkan tak mampu digigit terbuka oleh harimau.
